name: Star Health Assure Insurance Policy

room_rent.quote: Sum Insured in lakhs (Rs.) 5/7.5: Up to 1% of Sum Insured per day. 10/15/20/25: Any Room (Except suite or above category). 50/75/100/200: Any room
room_rent.note: Up to 1% SI per day for SI 5/7.5 Lakhs; Any Room (except suite) for SI 10-25 Lakhs; Any room for SI 50-200 Lakhs

proportionate.quote: Associated Medical expenses which vary based on the room occupied by the Insured Person will be considered in proportion to the room rent stated in the policy schedule or actuals whichever is less.

copay.quote: This policy is subject to co-payment of 10% of each and every claim amount for fresh as well as renewal policies for Insured Person whose age at the time of entry is 61 years and above.
copay.condition: Insured Person whose age at the time of entry is 61 years and above

waiting_initial.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident

waiting_ped.quote: Applicable for 3 year Policy Term: ... excluded until the expiry of 30 months ... Applicable for 1 year and 2 year Policy Term: ... excluded until the expiry of 36 months

specific_waits.quote: Treatment of Cataract and diseases of the anterior and posterior chamber of the Eye, Diseases of ENT, Diseases related to Thyroid, Benign diseases of the breast.
specific_waits.label: Cataract

specific_waits.quote: Diseases of ENT, Diseases related to Thyroid, Benign diseases of the breast.
specific_waits.label: ENT, Thyroid, Benign breast diseases

specific_waits.quote: Subcutaneous Benign Lumps, Sebaceous cyst, Dermoid cyst, Mucous cyst lip / cheek, Carpal Tunnel Syndrome, Trigger Finger, Lipoma, Neurofibroma, Fibroadenoma, Ganglion and similar pathology.
specific_waits.label: Benign Lumps and Cysts

specific_waits.quote: All treatments (Conservative, Operative treatment) and all types of intervention for Diseases related to Tendon, Ligament, Fascia, Bones and Joint Including Arthroscopy and Arthroplasty / Joint Replacement
specific_waits.label: Joint Replacement and Bone/Joint Diseases

specific_waits.quote: All types of treatment for Degenerative disc and Vertebral diseases including Replacement of bones and joints and Degenerative diseases of the Musculo-skeletal system, Prolapse of Intervertebral Disc
specific_waits.label: Degenerative Disc and Vertebral Diseases

specific_waits.quote: Hepato-pancreato-biliary diseases including Gall bladder and Pancreatic calculi. All types of management for Kidney calculi and Genitourinary tract calculi.
specific_waits.label: Calculi diseases

specific_waits.quote: Desmoid Tumor, Umbilical Granuloma, Umbilical Sinus, Umbilical Fistula.
specific_waits.label: Desmoid Tumor, Umbilical Sinus/Fistula

specific_waits.quote: Diseases of Cervix, Uterus, Fallopian tubes, Ovaries, Uterine Bleeding, Pelvic Inflammatory Diseases.
specific_waits.label: Gynaecological disorders

specific_waits.quote: All Diseases of Prostate, Stricture Urethra, all Obstructive Uropathies.
specific_waits.label: Prostate and Urological disorders

specific_waits.quote: Benign Tumours of Epididymis, Spermatocele, Varicocele, Hydrocele.
specific_waits.label: Hydrocele, Varicocele, Spermatocele

specific_waits.quote: Fistula, Fissure in Ano, Hemorrhoids, Pilonidal Sinus and Fistula, Rectal Prolapse, Stress Incontinence.
specific_waits.label: Piles, Fistula, Fissure

specific_waits.quote: All types of transplant and related surgeries.
specific_waits.label: Organ Transplant

specific_waits.quote: Congenital Internal disease / defect – {except for Unborn in Coverage (16) and New born in Coverage(18)}.
specific_waits.label: Congenital Internal Disease

specific_waits.quote: Benefit under this section is subject to a waiting period of 24 months from the date of first commencement of Star Health Assure Insurance policy
specific_waits.label: Delivery Expenses

specific_waits.quote: A waiting period of 24 months from the date of first inception of this policy with the Company for the Insured Person.
specific_waits.label: Assisted Reproduction Treatment

sublimits.quote: payable up to 10% of Sum Insured not exceeding Rs.5 lakhs per policy period per policy year.
sublimits.label: Chronic Severe Refractory Asthma

sublimits.quote: Expenses for a Delivery including Delivery by Caesarean section (including pre-natal and post natal expenses) up-to 10% of the Sum Insured is payable
sublimits.label: Delivery Expenses

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded.
Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment.
exclusions.text: Rest Cure, rehabilitation and respite care

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil all the below conditions
Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex.
Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an Accident, Burn(s) or Cancer
Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports
Expenses for treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent.
Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider specifically excluded by the Insurer
Treatment for Alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof
exclusions.text: Treatment for Alcoholism, drug or substance abuse

exclusions.quote: Treatments received in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas or similar establishments
exclusions.text: Spas, nature cure clinics, health hydros

exclusions.quote: Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription
Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres.
Expenses related to any unproven treatment, services and supplies for or in connection with any treatment.
Expenses related to sterility and infertility. (Except to the extent covered under Coverage 17)

Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalization) except ectopic pregnancy (Except to the extent covered under Coverage 15)
Circumcision (unless necessary for treatment of a disease not excluded under this policy or necessitated due to an accident), Preputioplasty, Frenuloplasty, Preputial Dilatation and Removal of SMEGMA
Congenital External Condition / Defects / Anomalies (except to the extent covered under Coverage 18)
Convalescence, general debility, run-down condition, Nutritional deficiency states
Intentional self-injury
Injury/disease caused by or arising from or attributable to war, invasion, act of foreign enemy, warlike operations
Injury or disease caused by or contributed to by nuclear weapons/ materials
Dental treatment or surgery unless necessitated due to accidental injuries and requiring hospitalization (Dental implants are not payable)
